inputs.goal: review the Acme MSA under our standard enterprise risk posture

clauses: All indemnification clauses must be reviewed for adequacy and alignment with enterprise risk tolerance
Insurance requirements must be assessed against standard coverage thresholds
Termination conditions should be evaluated for potential financial exposure
Compliance obligations must be verified against our regulatory framework
Data protection and privacy provisions need validation against enterprise security standards

redline.intake.summary: Acme MSA presents moderate risk exposure requiring careful evaluation of indemnification adequacy, insurance coverage thresholds, termination financial implications, regulatory compliance alignment, and data protection standard validation against enterprise security protocols.

redline.review.output: Acme MSA review completed with moderate risk exposure. Key findings include indemnification clauses requiring additional scope clarification, insurance coverage meeting minimum thresholds but lacking excess liability protection, termination conditions presenting potential financial exposure of up to $2M, regulatory compliance aligned with 85% of required frameworks but missing GDPR adherence, and data protection provisions compliant with 70% of enterprise standards requiring enhanced encryption protocols.
